Where can I find your full shipping policy?

Our shipping policy is pretty straightforward:

We ship to the U.S. and Canada only.
Canadian orders are not eligible for returns.
We don't ship internationally.

If you need more details or have a specific question about shipping, just let me know or reach out to us at support@simplemodern.com. I'm happy to help clarify anything!

Are any items final sale or non-returnable?

Yes, some items are final sale or non-returnable. Personalized or custom items, as well as certain limited edition products, can't be returned. Also, orders shipped to Canada aren't eligible for returns. Everything else that's unused and in original packaging can usually be returned within 90 days. If you're unsure about a specific item, just let me know and I can check for you!
